name: One&Only Cape Town
insider_take: This ultra-luxury urban resort sits on a private island in Cape Town's V&A Waterfront, offering unparalleled views of Table Mountain while being surrounded by working harbor waters.
whats_special: One&Only Cape Town is built on a man-made island connected by a private bridge, making it the only hotel in Africa situated entirely on its own island. The property features contemporary African design by Adam Tihany and houses the world-renowned Nobu restaurant - one of only three Nobu locations in Africa. The hotel's spa is the largest in the southern hemisphere, spanning 2,500 square meters across four floors.
pro_tip: Book a Marina Rise suite for the ultimate Table Mountain views, and time your arrival for sunset cocktails at the Vista Bar - the panoramic mountain backdrop creates an Instagram-worthy moment that's impossible to replicate elsewhere in the city.
dont_miss: The hotel's unique position offers direct yacht access for Table Bay cruises, while the adjacent V&A Waterfront provides world-class shopping and dining just steps away. The property's infinity pool appears to flow directly toward Table Mountain, creating one of the world's most spectacular pool experiences. Visit the Two Oceans Aquarium next door, or take the nearby cable car up Table Mountain for 360-degree city views.
pros: Spectacular waterfront location with panoramic views of Table Mountain
World-class spa and wellness facilities with signature treatments
Exceptional fine dining restaurants with award-winning cuisine
Luxurious accommodations with private marina access and yacht charters
cons: Limited beach access due to marina location
